_doc: Character rig proportions and joint pivots, shared by chars/rig.ts and the Blender character kit. Metres at scale 1 (total height ~1.25). +Y up, +Z forward (characters face +Z), character-left = +X. Positions marked 'pelvis space' are relative to the pelvis joint in the rest pose; everything else is relative to its parent joint. Limbs hang straight down (-Y) from their pivot in the rest pose.

torso._doc: Bean lathe: [radius, height above pelvis] control points, Catmull-Rom smoothed, then scaled z by scaleZ and x/z by the per-character girth. Pants cover the profile below beltY (1.1 cm proud of the shirt). The chest joint splits the spine: everything above chestPivotY bends with the chest.

head._doc: neckY is pelvis space; the head pivots at the neck and its centre sits centerAboveNeck above it.

face._doc: Head-centre space; features sit on the sphere surface at (x, y) and face outward along the normal.

hand._doc: Mitten centre sits offset below the wrist (end of the forearm). Thumb points forward; mirror x for the right hand.

foot._doc: Shoe = rounded ellipsoid of size [w, h, l]. Its centre is 'below' under the ankle (end of the shin) and 'forward' ahead of it, so the sole touches y = 0 in the rest pose. Toes turn out by toeOutDeg.

attach._doc: Where accessories go. 'bone' is the joint they follow.

hatBand._doc: a cap/beanie opening sits on this ring, tilted back so the front clears the brows

handGrip._doc: held items (the manager's mug, a laptop corner)
